column1: # DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2, Hong Kong release, update 1.7.3. KTGL on SDK 5.4.0 / NVN.
# Format: see dm/games/README.md. Build-specific addresses are not used by this profile.
# The opening tutorial uses both sticks; retain the complete controller layout.
# main calls GLSLC and the SDK movie library, so both subsdks are required.
# NPDM system resource is zero: no virtual address memory. Startup requests a 3.02 GB heap in the 3.25 GB heap region.
# Most shaders are in compressed LINKDATA members; six built-in outputs are compiled by subsdk0 at boot.
